sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide — HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM) — Page 5

excerptItems.text:
• Complete all required questions to set up your team. Most of the information you enter, such as
your Team Name, Captain, and other team details, can be changed later. This initial information
will be used to create and activate your team and associate it with the appropriate community and
related league information.
• Once you have completed the registration form, click Register My Team! You will then be prompted
to enter your payment information or, if available, select your current payment method already on
file.
• After completing your registration, you will receive a confirmation email with your team registration
details, important next steps, and upcoming dates and deadlines.
• League Management will then activate your team and assign you and/or the individuals designated
during registration as the Captain and Co-Captain(s). Once this is completed, your initial team
registration and setup will be complete.
• League Management will notify you when team rosters for your league have been unlocked and are
available for you to begin adding and managing your players.

sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — Rule 6.1.9.7 — Page 8

excerptItems.text:
6.1.9.7. The Picklebreaker™ shall be played only when the match is tied 2–2
following completion of all preceding rounds. The Picklebreaker™ features the
designated doubles teams that participated in the preceding rounds, rotating
in accordance with the Picklebreaker™ Rotation Rules. The Picklebreaker™
shall consist of one game to 15 points, win by two (2), using Rally Scoring.
Note: Picklebreaker matches will not be recorded in DUPR and do not reflect
on individual’s W/L record.

sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — Rules 6.2.3.1, 6.2.3.5 — Match Day Format — Page 9

excerptItems.text:
6.2.3.1. All Games: Games to 15 using Rally Scoring* (win by 1). 1 point per win. Two
one-minute timeouts per team/game but no timeouts in Picklebreaker. Teams
switch ends when the first team reaches 8 points. Visitors choose serve,
receive, side, or defer in games 1 and 3 and all mixed games.

6.2.3.5. Picklebreaker™ Game (Only played if tie at the end of all previous rounds -
12-12): Features all the mixed teams that played in the Mixed rounds. This will

sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — Rule 6.2.3 — Page 10

excerptItems.text:
be one game to 25 win by 2 using Rally Scoring. The winning team collects 3
additional points. (If there isn’t a tie, the leading team collects a 3-point
bonus.) Note: Picklebreaker matches will not be recorded in DUPR and do not
reflect on individual’s W/L record.
Teams are numbered 1–3 for Men’s Doubles, 4–6 for Women’s Doubles, and 7–12 for Mixed
Doubles. These team numbers correspond directly to the Match Score Sheet printed from the system.
We highly recommend assigning higher team numbers to teams with higher combined skill levels and
ratings (for instance, Team 6 should have a higher combined DUPR rating than Team 4 in Women’s or
Team 12 should be a higher team rating than Team 7 in Mixed Doubles).
